name: My First Real Potion
label: Quest
description: A child hidden away asks you to bring murloc eyes for her first real potion. She is eager to try mixing it herself.
intro: A child hidden away asks you to bring murloc eyes for her first real potion. She is eager to try mixing it herself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought me murloc eyes! I am so, so excited for my first REAL potion!
I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... You can do the mixing this time.
The child watches enthusiastically as you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.
Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
